limitations: Registration products inherit upstream georeferencing uncertainty; verify against the reference grid, not the source grid
Cross-modal matching evidence depends on scene structure; refusals are expected on flat or structure-free scenes
Refusals write no output; low_confidence outputs are flagged and need review before geometric use
Coverage is measured over the full source extent: partial-overlap scenes score lower by design
Band 1 only; window-based matcher, not a general keypoint detector
Global translation adjustment only; per-pair affine stays in rs:register_images and no bundle adjustment is performed
Disconnected scenes are reported, not solved; large edge residuals mean the pair graph disagrees with itself
Read-only evidence surface: multimodal tie points, model-selection evidence, and stack adjustment; products are written by the rs: operators
